text.setup: Wide stance, toes turned out, shins close to vertical. Grip inside your knees with arms straight down.
cues: Push your knees out over your toes and pull the slack out.
Spread the floor apart with your feet as you stand.
Finish by squeezing your hips through.
mistakes: Hips rising first and the knees caving in.
A stance so wide you can't push the knees out.
Starting with the hips too low.
